topic: Measurement: LTV, cohort retention, contribution margin, incrementality
body: Ever wonder why e-commerce giants like Amazon invest heavily in cohort analysis? It's about understanding customer behavior over time. Cohort retention analysis gives them insights to craft effective retention strategies. This isn't just about keeping customers, it's about knowing when and how they interact with your brand. Accurate Lifetime Value (LTV) measurement is equally crucial. It helps businesses optimize marketing spend and refine customer acquisition strategies. Knowing the true value of a customer can change how you allocate resources and tailor marketing efforts. In 2026, we're seeing analytics tools in APAC focusing on incrementality and contribution margins. These metrics offer deeper insights into what drives profitability beyond just sales figures. But there's a catch: integrating data accurately is complex and errors can skew results. The takeaway? Effective measurement isn't just about collecting data, it's about using it to make informed decisions. It's a challenge, but one worth tackling for the sake of better retention and smarter spending.
